name: Escape Avalanche for Penguins 🐧
desc:
Welcome to Escape Avalanche For Penguins! ❄️🐧

Run fast and rescue Penguins! 🏃‍♂️
Avoid deadly avalanches as they crash down! 🏔️❄️
Stay alive and collect as many Penguins as possible! ⚡
Upgrade your Penguins to earn more money! 💰
Upgrade your base to unlock more slots and place extra Penguins! 🏗️

Your Penguins earn cash OFFLINE! 💤💸

Like the game and join the group for FREE EPIC PENGUIN! 👍🐧
